annotation.title_clean: Se realizó el encuentro “Oportunidades y desafíos en Inteligencia Artificial”
annotation.title_en: The meeting "Opportunities and Challenges in Artificial Intelligence" was held
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia I+D+i / Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Argentina)
annotation.summary_en: Argentine government news item reporting a workshop on AI opportunities and challenges, organised by the Science Ministry, Agencia I+D+i and the IDB. It covers a US$35 million IDB-backed AI investment programme, sector working groups (agro, bioinformatics, logistics, mining) and constraints such as talent, data and ethics.
key_provisions_or_claims: IDB agreement of US$35 million for AI investment in Argentina
Plan Nacional de CTI 2030 includes AI as a priority axis
Sectoral working groups: agroindustry, bioinformatics, logistics, mining
Identified limits: public-private articulation, scarce skilled talent, data infrastructure and ethical responsibility
Call for public-private consortia to be shaped from workshop conclusions
